interface.name: nostromo_control_v1

description.summary: Small session controls over the authenticated Wayland connection

interface.description: Effect modes: 0 off, 1 static, 2 animated. Lock states: 0 unlocked, 1 compositor-enforced lock with a live lock client, 2 locked after client loss. This interface cannot unlock the session or execute a command.
